_meta.purpose: Knowledge Transfer (KT) document for onboarding a new AI agent onto the Sourcerer codebase. Read this before writing any code.

project_overview.name: Sourcerer
project_overview.description: An AI-powered RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) backend for educational content. It ingests documents from Google Drive, processes them through an 8-stage pipeline, stores embeddings in Qdrant, and exposes an agentic LLM-driven retrieval API.
project_overview.maturity: Early production — core pipeline working, retrieval live, reranking not yet implemented.

tech_stack.llm: llama-3.1-8b-instant via Groq API (also used for tagging)
tech_stack.search_strategy: Hybrid: Dense (Gemini) + Sparse (BM25 via Qdrant/bm25 fastembed) fused with RRF

folder_structure.app/core/config.py: Pydantic Settings singleton — all env vars live here
folder_structure.app/routes/ingestion.py: POST /api/v1/ingest/gdrive — triggers Celery task for each file
folder_structure.app/services/gdrive_service.py: Google Drive auth, recursive file listing, downloading
folder_structure.app/services/parsing/: File parsers (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, TXT, Markdown) via factory pattern
folder_structure.app/services/chunking/: Chunking strategies (PDF, DOCX, PPT, fixed-window, section) via factory
folder_structure.app/services/tagging/tagging_service.py: LLM tagging via Groq with multi-key round-robin rotation + 429 retry
folder_structure.app/services/embedding/embedding_service: Gemini multimodal embeddings — handles text+image chunks

stages.name: GDrive Ingestion
stages.what: Authenticates with service account, recursively lists and downloads supported files. Builds breadcrumb file_path. Supported: PDF, TXT, MD, DOCX, PPT, PPTX, Google Docs, Google Slides.
stages.output: List[FileRecord] — {file_id, file_name, mime_type, file_path, modified_time, content:bytes}

stages.name: Incremental Check
stages.what: MD5 hashes file content. Checks SQLite. Returns NEW | SKIP | UPDATE. If UPDATE → deletes existing Qdrant vectors for that file_id. Tracking DB only updated AFTER successful pipeline completion.
stages.critical: DO NOT update tracking store before pipeline completes

stages.name: Metadata Extraction
stages.what: Extracts course_code, year, tags from folder path breadcrumbs. Returns a metadata dict attached to all chunks.

stages.name: Parsing
stages.what: ParserFactory.get_parser(mime_type) returns correct parser. Each returns a ParsedDocument with a list of blocks (text or image). PDF uses PyMuPDF. DOCX/PPT uses Docling.

stages.name: Chunking
stages.what: chunk_document(parsed_doc, metadata, file_id) returns List[Chunk]. Chunk IDs are deterministic (hash-based). Strategies: pdf_chunker, docx_chunker, ppt_chunker, section_chunker, fixed_window_chunker.
stages.critical: Chunk IDs MUST be deterministic and stable across re-runs

stages.name: Tagging
stages.what: Uses Groq (llama-3.1-8b-instant) to extract {subject, topic, keywords[], difficulty} per text chunk. Images get empty tags. Supports multiple GROQ keys (round-robin). On 429 → tries all keys → waits 10s → final retry.

stages.name: Embedding
stages.what: Gemini gemini-embedding-2-preview. Text chunks: embeds description+text together. Image chunks: embeds description+image as multimodal. Output dimensionality: 2048 (QDRANT_VECTOR_SIZE in config). Query embedding uses task_type=RETRIEVAL_QUERY.

stages.name: Qdrant Storage
stages.what: Upserts points with named vectors: dense (list[float]) + sparse (BM25 via Qdrant/bm25 fastembed). Payload includes: text, file_id, course_code, year, content_type, source, page_number, subject, topic, keywords, difficulty.

stages.name: Tracking Update
stages.what: Only called after successful storage. Updates SQLite with new hash + timestamp.

ingestion_pipeline.async_execution: Stages 2-9 run inside process_file_task (Celery). The HTTP response from /ingest/gdrive returns immediately after queuing.

retrieval_pipeline.architecture: LangGraph ReAct agent loop: agent_node ↔ ToolNode
flow: 2. agent_node: System prompt + messages → LLM with bound tools
3. If LLM returns tool_call → ToolNode executes search_documents
4. search_documents: embeds query (RETRIEVAL_QUERY) → hybrid search via vector_store_service.search()
5. vector_store_service.search(): RRF fusion of dense + sparse prefetch queries
6. Results formatted as string → back to agent_node
7. Agent evaluates results → responds or calls tool again
9. Final message content returned as answer
system_prompt_rules: If insufficient info after search → respond exactly 'Insufficient info'
No prior knowledge — answer solely from retrieved docs

environment_variables.GDRIVE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH: Path to GCP service account JSON (e.g. secrets/key.json)
environment_variables.GROQ_API_KEY: Comma-separated list of Groq API keys for rotation
environment_variables.GEMINI_API_KEY: Google Gemini API key for embeddings

POST /api/v1/ingest/gdrive.response: List[FileResponse] — immediately after queuing Celery tasks
POST /api/v1/ingest/gdrive.note: Actual processing is async via Celery

POST /api/v1/retrieve/.note: Synchronous — waits for full LangGraph agent loop to complete

key_patterns_and_decisions.singleton_services: All service classes (EmbeddingService, VectorStoreService, IncrementalService) are instantiated as module-level singletons
key_patterns_and_decisions.factory_pattern: Parsers and chunkers use factory pattern — ParserFactory.get_parser(mime_type), ChunkerFactory.get_chunker(doc_type)
key_patterns_and_decisions.deterministic_chunk_ids: Chunk IDs are hash-based. Ensures idempotent re-ingestion without duplicates.
key_patterns_and_decisions.multi_key_groq_rotation: GROQ_API_KEY is comma-separated. Thread-safe round-robin rotation. On 429 → cycle all keys → 10s wait → final retry.
key_patterns_and_decisions.tracking_update_safety: Tracking DB updated ONLY on successful pipeline completion to prevent half-processed files being skipped.
key_patterns_and_decisions.hybrid_search: RRF fusion via Qdrant Query API with prefetch. DO NOT manually combine scores. DO NOT use weighted sum.
key_patterns_and_decisions.google_drive_export: Google Docs → DOCX, Google Slides → PPTX via Drive export API
key_patterns_and_decisions.image_embedding: Images are embedded multimodally with a text description derived from tags
key_patterns_and_decisions.no_overengineering: Prefer simple working version first. Avoid LangChain abstractions unless needed.

onboarding_checklist_for_new_agent: Read AGENTS.md for coding constraints and conventions
Read docs/arch.md for the system architecture diagram
Read docs/retrieval_module.md before touching retrieval code
Check .prompts/ folder for relevant design decisions before implementing a feature
Never use pip — always use uv
Use Google coding style (docstrings on all public functions)
Each new feature must be independently testable
Update tracking_store ONLY after successful pipeline completion
